Namespace ExcelCommon
    Public NotInheritable Class UdfContingencyPreparation38
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function ChiSquaredBody(tab(,) As Integer, isFinite As Func(Of Double, Boolean)) As Object(,)
                Dim res = contingencytable.Chi2TESTindependence(tab)
                If res.Item1 Is Nothing OrElse Not IsFinite(res.Item1.TestStatistics1) OrElse Not IsFinite(res.Item1.Pvalue) Then
                    Return Nothing
                End If

                Dim df As Integer = EffectiveDf(tab)
                Dim reportBody As Object(,) = {
                    {"Chi-square", res.Item1.TestStatistics1},
                    {"Degrees of freedom", df},
                    {"Two-sided p-value", res.Item1.Pvalue}
                }
                Return reportBody
        End Function

        Public Shared Function NominalAssociationBody(tab(,) As Integer) As Object(,)
                Dim res = contingencytable.Chi2TESTindependence(tab)
                If res.Item1 Is Nothing Then Return Nothing

                Dim reportBody As Object(,) = {
                    {"Cramer's V", res.Item2},
                    {"Pearson's contingency coefficient", res.Item3},
                    {"Phi", res.Item4}
                }
                Return reportBody
        End Function

        Public Shared Function Fisher2x2Body(tab(,) As Integer, isFinite As Func(Of Double, Boolean)) As Object(,)
                Dim res As TestResult = contingencytable.FisherExact2x2(tab(0, 0), tab(0, 1), tab(1, 0), tab(1, 1))
                If res Is Nothing OrElse Not IsFinite(res.Pvalue) Then Return Nothing

                Dim reportBody As Object(,) = {
                    {"One-sided exact p-value", res.PvalueLowerSide},
                    {"Two-sided exact p-value", res.Pvalue},
                    {"One-sided mid-p value", res.pValueExactLowerSide},
                    {"Two-sided mid-p value", res.Pvalue2}
                }
                Return reportBody
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FreemanHaltonBody(tab(,) As Integer, isFinite As Func(Of Double, Boolean)) As Object(,)
                Dim exact As New FisherExactEngine(tab)
                exact.Run()

                If Not IsFinite(exact.PObserved) OrElse Not IsFinite(exact.PValue) Then Return Nothing

                Dim reportBody As Object(,) = {
                    {"Observed-table probability", exact.PObserved},
                    {"Two-sided exact p-value", exact.PValue}
                }
                Return reportBody
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

    Public NotInheritable Class UdfAgreementReportPreparation38
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function BuildRegressionCoefficients(slope As ConfidenceIntervalResult, intercept As ConfidenceIntervalResult, title As String) As ResultTable
                Dim t As New ResultTable
                t.AddTitle(title)
                t.AddHeaderLeftRow({"Slope", "Intercept"})
                t.AddHeaderTopRow({"Estimate", slope.CIlabel, "Lower", "Upper"})
                t.SetBody(New Object(,) {
                    {slope.Estimate, slope.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL), slope.LowerLimit, slope.UpperLimit},
                    {intercept.Estimate, intercept.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL), intercept.LowerLimit, intercept.UpperLimit}
                })
                Return t
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildBlandAltmanStatistics(res As Agreement.BlandAltmanResult) As ResultTable
                Dim t As New ResultTable
                t.AddTitle("Bland–Altman Statistics")
                t.AddHeaderLeftRow({"Bias", "Lower LoA", "Upper LoA", "SD(diff)", "Repeatability coefficient"})
                t.AddHeaderTopRow({"Estimate", res.BiasCI.CIlabel, "Lower", "Upper"})
                t.SetBody(New Object(,) {
                    {res.BiasCI.Estimate, res.BiasCI.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL), res.BiasCI.LowerLimit, res.BiasCI.UpperLimit},
                    {res.LowerLoACI.Estimate, res.LowerLoACI.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL), res.LowerLoACI.LowerLimit, res.LowerLoACI.UpperLimit},
                    {res.UpperLoACI.Estimate, res.UpperLoACI.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL), res.UpperLoACI.LowerLimit, res.UpperLoACI.UpperLimit},
                    {res.SdDifference, "", "", ""},
                    {res.RepeatabilityCoefficient, "", "", ""}
                })
                Return t
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildRepeatability(rc As ConfidenceIntervalResult, title As String) As ResultTable
                Dim t As New ResultTable
                t.SetBody(New Object(,) {
                        {"Repeatability coefficient", rc.Estimate},
                        {rc.CIlabel, rc.strConfidenceInterval(CIformat.LL_to_UL)},
                        {"SEM (standard error of measurement)", rc.StdErr}
                    })
                t.AddHeaderTopRow({title, ""})
                Return t
        End Function
    End Class

Namespace ExcelCommon
    Public NotInheritable Class UdfClassificationReportPreparation38
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function BuildBinaryCrosstabUdfOutput(summary As BinaryClassificationSummary, missingValue As Object,
                                                     Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + 4
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 3) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Observed \ Predicted"
                out(0, 1) = 0
                out(0, 2) = 1
                out(0, 3) = "Recall %"
            End If

            out(rowOffset + 0, 0) = 0
            out(rowOffset + 0, 1) = summary.TN
            out(rowOffset + 0, 2) = summary.FP
            out(rowOffset + 0, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Specificity, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 1, 0) = 1
            out(rowOffset + 1, 1) = summary.FN
            out(rowOffset + 1, 2) = summary.TP
            out(rowOffset + 1, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Sensitivity, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 2, 0) = "Precision % / Overall"
            out(rowOffset + 2, 1) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.NPV, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 2, 2) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Precision, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 2, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Accuracy, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 3, 0) = "Threshold / Balanced accuracy"
            out(rowOffset + 3, 1) = summary.Threshold
            out(rowOffset + 3, 2) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.BalancedAccuracy, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 3, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.YoudenJ, missingValue)

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildThresholdTableUdfOutput(rows As IList(Of BinaryThresholdRow), missingValue As Object,
                                                     Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return missingValue

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + rows.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 13) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
                out(0, 1) = "TP"
                out(0, 2) = "FP"
                out(0, 3) = "TN"
                out(0, 4) = "FN"
                out(0, 5) = "Sensitivity %"
                out(0, 6) = "Specificity %"
                out(0, 7) = "Precision %"
                out(0, 8) = "Recall %"
                out(0, 9) = "NPV %"
                out(0, 10) = "Accuracy %"
                out(0, 11) = "BalancedAccuracy %"
                out(0, 12) = "YoudenJ %"
                out(0, 13) = "F1 %"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r As BinaryThresholdRow = rows(i)
                Dim rr As Integer = rowOffset + i
                out(rr, 0) = r.Threshold
                out(rr, 1) = r.TP
                out(rr, 2) = r.FP
                out(rr, 3) = r.TN
                out(rr, 4) = r.FN
                out(rr, 5) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Sensitivity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 6) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Specificity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 7) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Precision, missingValue)
                out(rr, 8) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Recall, missingValue)
                out(rr, 9) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.NPV, missingValue)
                out(rr, 10) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Accuracy, missingValue)
                out(rr, 11) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.BalancedAccuracy, missingValue)
                out(rr, 12) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.YoudenJ, missingValue)
                out(rr, 13) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.F1, missingValue)
            Next

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildCalibrationTableUdfOutput(rows As IList(Of CalibrationBinSummary), missingValue As Object,
                                                       Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return missingValue

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + rows.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 5) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Bin"
                out(0, 1) = "N"
                out(0, 2) = "MeanPredicted"
                out(0, 3) = "ObservedRate"
                out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
                out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r As CalibrationBinSummary = rows(i)
                Dim rr As Integer = rowOffset + i
                out(rr, 0) = r.BinIndex
                out(rr, 1) = r.N
                out(rr, 2) = r.MeanPredicted
                out(rr, 3) = r.ObservedRate
                out(rr, 4) = r.LowerCI
                out(rr, 5) = r.UpperCI
            Next

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildBrierScoreUdfOutput(score As Double, missingValue As Object,
                                                 Optional n As Double = Double.NaN,
                                                 Optional eventRate As Double = Double.NaN,
                                                 Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            If Not Double.IsNaN(n) Then totalRows += 1
            If Not Double.IsNaN(eventRate) Then totalRows += 1

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + totalRows
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 1) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Item"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
            End If

            Dim r As Integer = rowOffset
            out(r, 0) = "BrierScore"
            out(r, 1) = score
            r += 1

            If Not Double.IsNaN(n) Then
                out(r, 0) = "N"
                out(r, 1) = n
                r += 1
            End If

            If Not Double.IsNaN(eventRate) Then
                out(r, 0) = "EventRate"
                out(r, 1) = eventRate
            End If

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

        Private Shared Function PercentOrMissingValue(value As Double, missingValue As Object) As Object
            If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then Return missingValue
            Return 100.0R * value
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace
